id: Back to the Future Part III (1990)

ops.to: Double crust pie of tart apples, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Vodka, coffee liqueur and strong black coffee shaken ice cold.

value.note: Cola fizzed at the soda fountain with a shot of vanilla, no laughing gas.

ops.to: Scone dough rolled round Vegemite and tasty cheese, sliced and baked.
Fresh shucked oysters on crushed ice with a shallot and cracked pepper dressing.

id: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005)

ops.to: White fish, mussels and prawns in saffron broth, garlicky red sauce, for Fleur and her schoolmates.
Chunky smashed avocado with lime, cilantro, red onion and green chili, corn chips.
Toasted roast chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, fries alongside, from the beehive waitress.
Halved pears simmered in sugar syrup, under a quiet spoonful of vanilla custard.
Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and almonds, wrapped in prosciutto, honey drizzled. Good ones.
Crumbed pea and mint risotto balls with a mozzarella middle, green as Goodspeed's glass beads.

value.note: Whole garlic bulbs roasted soft and squeezed onto warm sourdough. Sapper grows his own.
